title: CmdPal: fix display configuration query to preserve monitor identity

proposed_comments.title: Cover the display-query boundary
proposed_comments.body:
The updated reconciler test does not exercise this fix: it constructs a `MonitorInfo` whose `StableId` is already correct, so it passes even with the previous non-null topology pointer and an empty display-info map. Please cover the display-query boundary via a testable native-call seam or an integration test, and assert that `QDC_ONLY_ACTIVE_PATHS` produces the device-path mapping; otherwise this exact regression can return unnoticed.

**Severity:** `medium`

confidence.rationale: The fresh Copilot review identifies a concrete coverage gap: the current test never invokes MonitorService or the corrected native display-query path, while the upstream build and targeted test suite pass.

actions.label: Post inline review finding
actions.note: Revalidate the upstream head and activity snapshot, validate the pinned review payload, and obtain explicit maintainer approval before publishing.
